positions.commentary: Tesla's approach represents disruption at a micro level within an organization, challenging traditional PC and car manufacturing models.

thesis: This episode argues that Tesla's competitive advantage stems from a fundamentally different organizational structure and design philosophy compared to legacy automakers. Specifically, it posits that Tesla's software-centric approach, integrated component design, and ability to deploy features over-the-air create a structural moat that traditional companies, reliant on specialized hardware silos, struggle to replicate.
